title: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
title_zh: WaitLens：基于时序VLM的工业GUI测试智能体自适应等待

paragraphs.en: Improving the efficiency of GUI testing agents is important for industrial deployment. Beyond LLM inference, fixed waiting between consecutive interactions introduces substantial overhead. Our industrial study reveals that fixed waiting accounts for 42.3% of the time within the sampled interaction intervals, comparable to the 54.8% spent on model calls. Moreover, 62.9% of the waiting time is spent after the GUI has already finished loading. Although prior studies have proposed adaptive waiting strategies, their reliance on app-specific data or platform-specific information limits their applicability across diverse industrial environments. To this end, we propose WaitLens , which fine-tunes a lightweight VLM on GUI loading trajectories annotated with waiting end times. We introduce temporal resampling to construct diverse training examples, enabling the model to learn varying GUI loading behaviors from temporal observations. Experiments show that WaitLens achieves 86.08% accuracy in deciding whether to keep waiting, compared with 54.13% for the backbone VLM. Our evaluation using recordings from Meituan’s industrial testing pipeline shows that WaitLens reduces mean extra waiting after the interface is ready by 94.98% compared with a 20 s fixed wait.

paragraphs.en: Recently, large language model (LLM) based GUI agents have emerged as a new testing method, which reduces reliance on manually maintained test scripts [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Given natural language testing tasks, these agents repeatedly observe GUI screenshots, reason about subsequent actions, and interact with apps to complete testing tasks. As illustrated in Figure 1 , each action is followed by a waiting period before the agent captures the next screenshot, allowing the interface to respond.

paragraphs.en: Determining an appropriate waiting time, however, is challenging. If the wait is too short, agents may mistake an intermediate loading state for the result of the preceding action, leading to incorrect decisions [ 9 , 10 ] . To accommodate slow responses, existing GUI agents often adopt fixed waiting times after each action [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] . However, a long fixed wait also keeps agents idle when the interface becomes ready earlier. Our motivation study in Section II-B shows that 62.9% of the waiting time in our industrial GUI testing agent is spent idling after the GUI has already finished loading. This substantial overhead motivates adaptive waiting policies in GUI testing agents.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，确定合适的等待时间颇具挑战性。 如果等待时间过短，智能体可能会将中间加载状态误认为是前一个动作的结果，从而导致错误的决策 [ 9 , 10 ] 。 为了适应较慢的响应，现有的 GUI 智能体通常在每个动作之后采用固定的等待时间 [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] 。 然而，较长的固定等待时间也会在界面提前就绪时让智能体处于闲置状态。 我们在第 II-B 节中的动机研究表明，在我们的工业级 GUI 测试智能体中，62.9% 的等待时间是在 GUI 已经完成加载之后的闲置时间。 这一可观的额外开销促使 GUI 测试智能体采用自适应等待策略。

paragraphs.en: Although prior studies have explored adaptive waiting for GUI testing [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] , these methods face limitations when applied to GUI agents across diverse industrial environments. First, learning-based methods rely on app-specific training data and may struggle with unseen GUIs. For example, AdaT [ 14 ] uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify GUI rendering states. To adapt AdaT to WeChat, WeReplay [ 15 ] collects new training data from the app and fine-tunes the model. Second, analysis-based methods rely on internal runtime or platform-specific information that screenshot-based agents cannot directly access. For example, Zhang et al. [ 16 ] monitor DOM changes, while TurboDroid [ 17 ] uses method dependency analysis to determine waiting conditions. Therefore, GUI agents need an adaptive waiting approach that relies only on screenshots and can generalize across different GUIs.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有研究探索了面向 GUI 测试的自适应等待 [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] ，但这些方法应用于跨多样化工业环境的智能体时存在局限。 首先，基于学习的方法依赖特定应用的训练数据，在面对未见过的 GUI 时可能表现不佳。 例如，AdaT [ 14 ] 使用卷积神经网络（CNN）对 GUI 渲染状态进行分类。 为了将 AdaT 适配到微信，WeReplay [ 15 ] 从该应用收集新的训练数据并对模型进行微调。 其次，基于分析的方法依赖内部运行时或平台特定的信息，而基于截图的智能体无法直接获取这些信息。 例如，Zhang 等人 [ 16 ] 监控 DOM 变化，而 TurboDroid [ 17 ] 使用方法依赖分析来确定等待条件。 因此，智能体需要一种仅依赖截图、且能泛化到不同 GUI 的自适应等待方法。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in understanding diverse GUIs [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] , making them a promising alternative. However, directly applying existing VLMs to adaptive waiting is impractical for two reasons. First, unlike static GUI tasks, judging whether an interface has finished loading requires observing how the screen changes over time [ 22 , 23 ] . Simply feeding all historical screenshots into a VLM increases input size and inference latency as loading continues. This may offset the time saved by adaptive waiting. Second, general-purpose VLMs are not specifically trained to distinguish loading states from completed interfaces. As a result, they may struggle to accurately predict whether the GUI is ready.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在理解多样化图形用户界面（GUI）方面展现出强大的能力[18, 19, 20, 21]，使其成为一种有前景的替代方案。 然而，直接将现有的视觉语言模型应用于自适应等待并不可行，原因有二。 首先，与静态GUI任务不同，判断一个界面是否已完成加载需要观察屏幕随时间的变化[22, 23]。 简单地将所有历史截图输入视觉语言模型，会随着加载的持续而增加输入规模和推理延迟。 这可能抵消自适应等待所节省的时间。 其次，通用视觉语言模型并未经过专门训练来区分加载状态与已完成的界面。 因此，它们可能难以准确预测GUI是否已就绪。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose WaitLens , an VLM-based approach for adaptive waiting in GUI testing agents. Instead of waiting for a fixed duration, WaitLens periodically checks the screen after each action to decide when testing should proceed. To capture interface changes within a bounded input size, WaitLens uses a sliding window of screenshots as input to model. During VLM fine-tuning, we use temporal resampling to augment the training data and simulate different GUI loading speeds. Together, these designs enable WaitLens to predict GUI readiness across diverse loading conditions with low inference overhead.

paragraphs.en: We conduct comprehensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of WaitLens . Our in-house experiments show that WaitLens achieves 86.08% accuracy in GUI readiness prediction, compared with 54.13% for the backbone VLM Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct [ 24 ] . Moreover, we evaluate WaitLens using industrial GUI testing recordings from Meituan, a major Chinese local-services platform with over 800 million transacting users [ 25 ] . In our industrial replay evaluation, WaitLens reduces mean post-Ready waiting by 94.98% compared with the existing fixed waiting strategy. We further analyze representative failure cases to understand the remaining challenges and identify directions for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了全面的实验以评估 WaitLens 的有效性。 我们的内部实验表明，WaitLens 在 GUI 就绪预测中达到 86.08% 的准确率，而骨干视觉语言模型 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct [24] 仅为 54.13%。 此外，我们使用来自美团（Meituan）的工业级 GUI 测试录制数据对 WaitLens 进行了评估。美团是中国主要的本地服务平台，拥有超过 8 亿交易用户 [25]。 在我们的工业回放评估中，与现有的固定等待策略相比，WaitLens 将就绪后的平均等待时间减少了 94.98%。 我们进一步分析了代表性失败案例，以理解仍然存在的挑战并确定未来研究的方向。

paragraphs.en: We share industrial observations that identify fixed post-action waiting as a primary source of overhead in GUI testing agents. Our motivation study reveals that over 60% of the fixed waiting time is wasted after the interface is already ready.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分享了工业界观察，指出动作后的固定等待是 GUI 测试智能体开销的主要来源。 我们的动机研究显示，超过 60% 的固定等待时间是在界面已经就绪之后被浪费掉的。

paragraphs.en: We introduce WaitLens , an VLM-based adaptive waiting approach that learns when to end waiting from temporal GUI observations. We make this approach practical by fine-tuning a lightweight open-source VLM on annotated GUI loading sequences.

paragraphs.en: Industrial mobile GUI testing has traditionally relied on automated exploration [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] and manually maintained test scripts [ 29 , 30 ] . More recently, LLM-based GUI testing agents have been introduced to execute test tasks described in natural language [ 4 , 6 ] . In industrial regression testing, these agents may run across diverse devices and network conditions to cover different user environments [ 31 ] ( e.g. , AWS Device Farm [ 32 ] and Firebase Test Lab [ 33 ] ). Differences in hardware capabilities and network conditions can lead to substantial variations in GUI loading time, ranging from less than a second to tens of seconds. Unlike random exploration tools, GUI testing agents rely on the outcome of each interaction to plan subsequent actions. Observing the screen too early risks capturing blank screens, loading spinners, or other intermediate loading states that mislead the agent into incorrect actions. To avoid such errors, existing GUI agent implementations often adopt configurable fixed waiting times [ 12 , 11 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 工业级移动 GUI 测试传统上依赖于自动化探索 [26, 27, 28] 和人工维护的测试脚本 [29, 30]。 近来，基于 LLM 的 GUI 测试智能体已被引入，用于执行以自然语言描述的测试任务 [4, 6]。 在工业回归测试中，这些智能体可能在多样的设备和网络条件下运行，以覆盖不同的用户环境 [31]（例如 AWS Device Farm [32] 和 Firebase Test Lab [33]）。 硬件能力和网络条件的差异会导致 GUI 加载时间出现显著变化，从不到一秒到数十秒不等。 与随机探索工具不同，GUI 测试智能体依赖每次交互的结果来规划后续动作。 过早观察屏幕可能捕获到空白屏幕、加载动画或其他中间加载状态，从而误导智能体做出错误动作。 为避免此类错误，现有的 GUI 智能体实现通常采用可配置的固定等待时间 [12, 11, 34, 35, 36]。

paragraphs.en: At Meituan, we deploy GUI testing agents [ 4 , 8 ] to verify mobile services including food delivery, hotel booking, and retail. Our testing pipeline executes tasks across a shared pool of physical devices, including resource-constrained smartphones. To accommodate slow-loading interfaces, the configuration examined in this study adopts a fixed 20-second waiting interval after each interaction before the agent captures its next screenshot. To investigate the overhead introduced by this waiting strategy, we analyze real-world GUI agent executions from Meituan in the following subsection.

paragraphs.en: To quantify the waiting overhead in industrial GUI testing agents, we investigate the following question: How much execution time do GUI testing agents spend on fixed waiting, and how much of that waiting is unnecessary?
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化工业 GUI 测试智能体中的等待开销，我们研究了以下问题：GUI 测试智能体在固定等待上花费了多少执行时间，其中有多少等待是不必要的？

paragraphs.en: We collect 100 screen recordings of GUI testing agent executions from Meituan’s regression pipeline, covering four low-end devices under slow network conditions. The pipeline adopts a fixed waiting interval of W = 20 W=20 seconds after each interaction. Following prior work [ 14 ] , we focus on click interactions, yielding 468 clicks. We regard an interface as Ready when the primary response to the preceding action has appeared and provides sufficient information for the agent’s next observation. For each click, two annotators independently identify the earliest time when the interface reaches the Ready state, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从美团的回归测试流水线中收集了 100 段 GUI 测试智能体执行过程的屏幕录像，涵盖四台处于慢速网络环境下的低端设备。 该流水线在每次交互后采用固定的等待间隔 W = 20 W=20 秒。 参照已有工作 [ 14 ] ，我们聚焦于点击交互，共得到 468 次点击。 当针对前一个操作的主要响应已经出现，并且能为智能体的下一次观察提供充分信息时，我们认为界面处于就绪（Ready）状态。 对于每次点击，由两名标注者独立标注界面达到就绪状态的最早时间，分歧由第三名审核者裁定。

paragraphs.en: We measure two complementary metrics: Ready latency and post-Ready waiting . Specifically, we break down the time within the sampled interaction intervals into fixed waiting, model calls, and other time, including action execution. Ready latency measures the elapsed time from action completion to the moment the interface reaches Ready. It reflects how quickly the interface becomes sufficient for the agent’s next observation. Post-Ready waiting measures the time between reaching Ready and the end of the 20-second fixed waiting interval. It is zero when Ready latency is at least 20 seconds. A higher value indicates more redundant waiting after the interface is sufficient for the agent’s next observation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们测量两个互补的指标：Ready 延迟和 Ready 后等待。 具体而言，我们将采样到的交互区间内的时间分解为固定等待、模型调用和其他时间（包括动作执行）。 Ready 延迟测量从动作完成到界面达到 Ready 所经过的时间。 它反映界面多快变得足以支持智能体的下一次观察。 Ready 后等待测量从达到 Ready 到 20 秒固定等待区间结束之间的时间。 当 Ready 延迟至少为 20 秒时，该值为零。 该值越高，表明在界面已足以支持智能体的下一次观察之后存在越多冗余等待。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 shows the distribution of Ready latency. The median latency is 6.97 seconds, substantially shorter than the configured 20-second wait. At the same time, response times vary widely across interactions. Overall, 463 out of 468 clicks (98.9%) reach Ready within 20 seconds, while the remaining five require longer. Consequently, post-Ready waiting averages 12.58 seconds per click, accounting for 62.9% of the total fixed waiting time. paragraphs.en: These findings highlight the limitations of fixed waiting. Shorter intervals reduce redundant waiting but increase the risk of premature observations, while longer intervals accommodate slow responses at the cost of additional waiting. Therefore, adaptive waiting is needed to balance testing effectiveness and efficiency across diverse GUI interactions.

paragraphs.en: WaitLens is a VLM-based adaptive waiting plugin for GUI testing agents. It replaces the fixed waiting time after each interaction by determining when the interface is ready for the next observation.
paragraphs.zh: WaitLens 是一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自适应等待插件，用于 GUI 测试智能体。 它通过判断界面何时准备好进行下一次观察，来取代每次交互后固定的等待时间。

sents.en: WaitLens is a VLM-based adaptive waiting plugin for GUI testing agents.
sents.zh: WaitLens 是一个基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的自适应等待插件，用于 GUI 测试智能体。

sents.en: It replaces the fixed waiting time after each interaction by determining when the interface is ready for the next observation.
sents.zh: 它通过判断界面何时准备好进行下一次观察，来取代每次交互后固定的等待时间。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 4 (right), WaitLens is invoked immediately after the agent completes an action. During online waiting, WaitLens periodically captures the latest screenshot and combines it with the pre-interaction screenshot and a limited number of recent historical screenshots. The trained VLM uses this temporal visual input to predict whether the GUI has reached the Ready state. Waiting ends early once the model produces the required number of consecutive ready predictions. WaitLens then returns the latest checked screenshot to the agent for its next observation. Otherwise, it continues checking subsequent screenshots. If the original waiting budget expires before this condition is met, WaitLens returns the latest available screenshot.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 4（右）所示，WaitLens 在智能体完成一个动作后立即被调用。 在在线等待期间，WaitLens 周期性地捕获最新截图，并将其与交互前的截图以及有限数量的近期历史截图相结合。 训练好的 VLM 使用这一时序视觉输入来预测 GUI 是否已达到 Ready 状态。 一旦模型产生所需数量的连续就绪预测，等待即提前结束。 随后，WaitLens 将最新检查过的截图返回给智能体，作为其下一次观察。 否则，它会继续检查后续截图。 如果在满足该条件之前原始等待预算已耗尽，WaitLens 则返回最新的可用截图。

paragraphs.en: To train the VLM, we construct labeled visual sequences from annotated interaction recordings and augment them through temporal resampling. We then fine-tune a lightweight pretrained VLM (Qwen3-VL-2B) using these samples, as illustrated in Figure 4 (left).

paragraphs.en: A single screenshot may not reveal whether the GUI has reached the Ready state, as the GUI evolves over time. For example, Figure 5 shows that the playlist header appears at 1.25 s, while the song list does not appear until 1.50 s. Without observing this change, the earlier screenshot may be mistakenly considered Ready. Therefore, we organize the VLM input using three complementary types of screenshots to capture GUI changes over time. paragraphs.en: To support integration with diverse agents and applications, we design WaitLens as a non-intrusive, agent-agnostic plugin. Specifically, WaitLens integrates into screenshot-based GUI agents by replacing the fixed waiting period between action execution and the next observation, as shown in the upper of Figure 4 . Upon action completion at t 0 t_{0} , the agent provides WaitLens with the pre-interaction screenshot, screenshot access, and its original waiting budget W W . The plugin determines when to return the next screenshot without modifying the agent’s reasoning or action-execution logic. Moreover, it operates entirely on screenshots, requiring no application instrumentation, source-code modification, or view-hierarchy access.

paragraphs.en: During online waiting, WaitLens samples screenshots at interval Δ \Delta and maintains a history of up to K K screenshots. The waiting budget W W sets a deadline at t 0 + W t_{0}+W . At each check, the fine-tuned VLM predicts whether the current interface is ready using the temporal visual input described in Section III-B . To reduce prediction fluctuations, WaitLens supports a configurable threshold n n that requires n n consecutive ready predictions before returning. Once this condition is met, WaitLens ends waiting and returns the latest checked screenshot to the agent. Otherwise, it continues checking until the original waiting budget W W expires. If no ready prediction is obtained by then, WaitLens returns the latest available screenshot. This allows the agent to resume earlier when the GUI is ready while retaining the original waiting budget as a fallback.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate WaitLens using GUI interaction recordings collected from Meituan’s industrial testing pipeline. Our evaluation examines GUI readiness prediction and waiting-policy performance through offline replay. Specifically, we address the following research questions (RQs):
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用从美团工业测试流水线中收集的GUI交互录制数据来评估WaitLens。 我们的评估通过离线回放考察GUI就绪预测和等待策略的性能。 具体而言，我们回答以下研究问题（RQ）：

sents.en: We evaluate WaitLens using GUI interaction recordings collected from Meituan’s industrial testing pipeline.
sents.zh: 我们使用从美团工业测试流水线中收集的GUI交互录制数据来评估WaitLens。

paragraphs.zh: RQ1：WaitLens 预测 GUI 就绪状态的准确性和效率如何，时间重采样对其性能有何影响？

paragraphs.en: RQ2: How effectively can WaitLens reduce extra waiting time while minimizing premature returns in industrial GUI testing?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2：WaitLens 在工业 GUI 测试中减少额外等待时间的同时，将过早返回降到最低的效果如何？

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we use 102 annotated interaction recordings covering 12 testing tasks from Meituan. We split the tasks into training, validation, and test sets with 7, 2, and 3 tasks, respectively. All recordings and derived observations from the same task are assigned to the same set to avoid data leakage. Following Section III-C , we construct 994 training, 700 validation, and 848 test observations using regular sampling and temporal resampling. To evaluate readiness prediction under both regular sampling and varying observation intervals, the test set contains 424 regularly sampled and 424 temporally resampled observations.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ1，我们使用了来自美团的 102 条带标注的交互记录，涵盖 12 个测试任务。 我们将这些任务划分为训练集、验证集和测试集，分别包含 7 个、2 个和 3 个任务。 来自同一任务的所有记录及其派生的观测都会被分配到同一个集合中，以避免数据泄露。 按照 III-C 节的方法，我们使用常规采样和时间重采样构建了 994 条训练观测、700 条验证观测和 848 条测试观测。 为了在常规采样和不同观测间隔两种情况下评估就绪预测，测试集包含 424 条常规采样的观测和 424 条时间重采样的观测。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , we use a larger dataset collected from Meituan’s daily regression testing pipeline to evaluate waiting policies through offline replay. Of these, 512 recordings (1,670 interactions) are captured directly from device screens, while 589 recordings (2,198 interactions) are captured by external cameras using physical test rigs. We geometrically correct the external recordings to align their frames with the screen viewport. Figure 7 shows examples of the two recording types. The earliest Ready time for each interaction was annotated by Meituan testing personnel, providing ground truth for evaluating premature returns and post-Ready waiting. The RQ1 and RQ2 datasets contain no overlapping recordings.

paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we compare WaitLens with four baselines: pretrained Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, Qwen3.8-Max [ 37 ] , AdaT [ 14 ] , and a variant of WaitLens trained without temporal resampling. The Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct evaluates the effect of fine-tuning, while Qwen3.8-Max serves as a larger general-purpose VLM baseline. Both VLMs receive the same temporal visual input as WaitLens . For AdaT, we use its released MobileNet classifier with the current screenshot, mapping its fully and partially rendered predictions to ready and not_ready , respectively. We also evaluate an ablation variant of WaitLens . It is trained without temporal resampling, using only D G D_{G} , whereas the complete model is trained on D G ∪ C ⋆ D_{G}\cup C^{\star} .
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ1，我们将 WaitLens 与四个基线进行比较：预训练的 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct、Qwen3.8-Max [37]、AdaT [14]，以及一个未使用时序重采样训练的 WaitLens 变体。 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 用于评估微调的效果，而 Qwen3.8-Max 则作为更大型的通用视觉语言模型基线。 两个视觉语言模型接收与 WaitLens 相同的时序视觉输入。 对于 AdaT，我们使用其发布的 MobileNet 分类器处理当前截图，并将其完全渲染和部分渲染的预测分别映射为 ready 和 not_ready。 我们还评估了 WaitLens 的一个消融变体。 该变体在不使用时序重采样的情况下训练，仅使用 D_G，而完整模型则在 D_G ∪ C⋆ 上训练。

Both WaitLens and AdaT use the same maximum waiting budget of W = 20 W=20 s and follow the return and deadline rules in Section III-D . paragraphs.en: For RQ1 , we treat predicting whether the GUI is Ready as a binary classification task with ready as the positive class. We report Accuracy, false positive rate (FPR), and false negative rate (FNR). A false positive classifies an unready interface as ready , which may cause a premature return. A false negative classifies a Ready interface as not_ready , leading to additional checks and longer waiting times. Since the waiting policy may lead to repeated model calls, we also measure the latency of each model call. In detail, we report the median and 95th percentile (P95) model-call latency. Both are measured from submitting the prepared visual input to receiving the prediction, including network latency for API-based models.
paragraphs.zh: 对于RQ1，我们将预测GUI是否为Ready视为一个二分类任务，其中ready为正类。 我们报告准确率、假阳性率（FPR）和假阴性率（FNR）。 假阳性是将未就绪的界面分类为ready，这可能导致过早返回。 假阴性是将Ready的界面分类为not_ready，从而导致额外的检查和更长的等待时间。 由于等待策略可能导致重复的模型调用，我们还测量了每次模型调用的延迟。 具体而言，我们报告模型调用延迟的中位数和第95百分位数（P95）。 两者的测量均从提交准备好的视觉输入开始，到接收预测结果为止，包括基于API的模型的网络延迟。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2 , we use three metrics to evaluate each waiting policy. First, the premature return rate (PRR) is the proportion of interactions in which the returned screenshot was captured before the GUI reached Ready. Second, actual waiting time measures the elapsed time from action completion until the policy returns a screenshot, including checking overhead. Third, extra waiting after Ready measures the time spent waiting after the GUI reaches Ready and is set to zero for premature returns. We report PRR and the mean and P95 of both time metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 针对 RQ2，我们使用三个指标来评估每种等待策略。 首先，过早返回率（PRR）是指返回的截图在 GUI 达到 Ready 之前被捕获的交互所占比例。 其次，实际等待时间衡量从动作完成到策略返回截图为止所经过的时间，包括检查开销。 第三，Ready 后额外等待时间衡量 GUI 达到 Ready 之后继续等待的时间，对于过早返回的情况该值设为零。 我们报告 PRR 以及两个时间指标的均值和 P95。

paragraphs.en: The ablation results further show the contribution of temporal resampling. paragraphs.en: Beyond evaluating individual predictions in RQ1, RQ2 examines how effectively WaitLens controls the post-action waiting process in industrial testing. In live online testing, network fluctuations introduce unpredictable variations in interface loading times, which can cause the agent’s subsequent execution trajectory to diverge and make it difficult to fairly compare different waiting policies. Therefore, to conduct a strictly controlled comparison, we collect 3,868 interaction response processes from Meituan’s daily regression pipeline. We execute all waiting policies on the exact same production response streams and incorporate the measured duration of every check into the waiting timeline.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 RQ1 中对单个预测的评估之外，RQ2 考察 WaitLens 在工业测试中对操作后等待过程的控制效果如何。 在真实线上测试中，网络波动会导致界面加载时间出现不可预测的变化，这可能使智能体的后续执行轨迹产生偏离，从而难以公平地比较不同的等待策略。 因此，为了进行严格受控的比较，我们从美团的日常回归流水线中收集了 3,868 个交互响应过程。 我们在完全相同的生产响应流上执行所有等待策略，并将每次检查所测得的时长纳入等待时间线中。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table II , Meituan’s default 20 s fixed waiting strategy achieves a near-zero PRR of 0.13%. But this conservative strategy incurs an average of 17.957 s of extra waiting after the interface reaches Ready. In comparison, WaitLens reduces mean actual waiting from 20.000 s to 2.222 s (P95 of 4.023 s). It also reduces mean extra waiting by 94.98%, from 17.957 s to 0.901 s (P95 of 1.558 s). However, these savings come with a higher PRR of 15.64%, indicating that premature returns remain a challenge. Only 2.53% of interactions reach the 20-second fallback deadline.
paragraphs.zh: 如表II所示，美团默认的20秒固定等待策略实现了接近于零的PRR，仅为0.13%。 但这种保守策略在界面达到Ready后平均会产生17.957秒的额外等待。 相比之下，WaitLens将平均实际等待时间从20.000秒降低到2.222秒（P95为4.023秒）。 它还将平均额外等待时间降低了94.98%，从17.957秒降至0.901秒（P95为1.558秒）。 然而，这些节省伴随着15.64%的较高PRR，表明过早返回仍然是一个挑战。 只有2.53%的交互触达了20秒的回退期限。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, comparisons with shorter fixed waiting durations demonstrate that simply reducing a static threshold cannot replicate the efficiency-reliability balance of WaitLens . Because interface response times vary widely across interactions, any single static duration faces a rigid trade-off. Conservative settings of 10 s and 5 s keep PRR relatively low (2.25% and 8.04%, respectively). However, they still incur 8.027 s and 3.268 s of mean extra waiting, respectively, more than three to eight times that of WaitLens .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，与较短的固定等待时长的对比表明，仅仅降低静态阈值无法复现 WaitLens 的效率与可靠性平衡。 由于界面响应时间在不同交互之间差异很大，任何单一的静态时长都面临刚性的权衡。 保守设置 10 秒和 5 秒使 PRR 保持在较低水平（分别为 2.25% 和 8.04%）。 然而，它们仍然分别带来 8.027 秒和 3.268 秒的平均额外等待，是 WaitLens 的三到八倍以上。

paragraphs.en: Conversely, shortening the fixed wait to 2 s or 1 s to approach WaitLens ’s roughly 2 s waiting time causes PRR to surge to 23.60% and 71.79%, respectively. Such aggressive thresholds frequently return unready interfaces to the agent. Even compared with a 3 s fixed wait (13.16% PRR), WaitLens reduces mean actual waiting by 25.9% and mean extra waiting by 38.8%, with a slightly higher PRR of 15.64%. However, the suitability of a 3 s threshold can only be assessed retrospectively from the observed response times. In online testing, a fixed threshold selected from historical data may not generalize to changing device and network conditions. In contrast, WaitLens dynamically determines when to end waiting based on the observed GUI state, without requiring a predefined threshold tailored to the response time distribution.

paragraphs.en: Compared with the prior learning-based baseline AdaT, WaitLens achieves substantially higher reliability in returning ready interfaces. In industrial testing, an adaptive policy offers little practical value if it reduces waiting time mainly by returning unready interfaces. AdaT’s PRR reaches 90.80%, meaning that more than nine out of ten interactions return unready interfaces. By leveraging temporal VLM reasoning, WaitLens reduces PRR by 75.16 percentage points to 15.64%.
paragraphs.zh: 与先前的学习型基线 AdaT 相比，WaitLens 在返回就绪接口方面实现了显著更高的可靠性。 在工业测试中，如果一个自适应策略主要通过返回未就绪的接口来减少等待时间，那么它几乎没有实用价值。 AdaT 的 PRR 达到 90.80%，这意味着每十次交互中有超过九次返回未就绪的接口。 通过利用时序 VLM 推理，WaitLens 将 PRR 降低了 75.16 个百分点，降至 15.64%。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we evaluate WaitLens across internal screen recordings and external camera recordings, achieving PRRs of 12.87% and 17.74%, respectively. Despite not being trained on external camera recordings, WaitLens maintains comparable performance on this unseen recording modality. These results demonstrate its potential to generalize across different recording setups in industrial GUI testing.

paragraphs.en: The first failure pattern involves incomplete content on an otherwise structured page. Specifically, the page structure is already visible, but the main content is still missing. Similarly, in Case 02, the map and merchant title are displayed, while the merchant details and deals appear later. Without explicit loading indicators, the missing content may resemble intentionally empty regions, causing the model to predict ready prematurely.

paragraphs.en: Together, these cases illustrate the limitations of relying solely on visual observations to determine GUI readiness. paragraphs.en: Second, the efficiency benefit of adaptive waiting depends on the waiting time it can avoid relative to its checking cost. Screenshot sampling determines when visual evidence becomes available, while input preparation and model execution introduce further delay. For fast interactions with short fixed waits, these costs can leave little room for improvement. Model selection and sampling frequency should therefore account for the host’s waiting budget and deployment latency alongside prediction accuracy.

paragraphs.en: Annotators may differ in identifying the earliest ready time for progressively rendered interfaces. paragraphs.en: Moreover, our findings may not generalize to all applications, interaction types, and device conditions. paragraphs.en: Recent advances in LLMs have facilitated the development of autonomous GUI testing agents [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 6 , 38 , 8 , 5 ] , reducing the reliance on manually written test scripts [ 29 , 30 ] . For example, GPTDroid [ 1 ] leverages LLMs to guide functionality-aware GUI exploration, while DroidAgent [ 2 ] autonomously generates testing goals and interacts with apps to achieve them. More recently, AUITestAgent [ 4 ] enables automated GUI interaction and functional verification based on natural-language test requirements. Despite their different testing objectives, these agents generally follow an iterative process: observing GUI states, reasoning about subsequent actions, and interacting with apps. Existing studies primarily focus on improving test generation, exploration, and verification. In contrast, our work investigates an orthogonal problem: reducing the waiting overhead between consecutive interactions without compromising testing effectiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展促进了自主GUI测试智能体的开发[1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 38, 8, 5]，降低了对手动编写的测试脚本的依赖[29, 30]。 例如，GPTDroid[1]利用大语言模型来引导功能感知的GUI探索，而DroidAgent[2]则自主生成测试目标并与应用交互以实现这些目标。 更近期的AUITestAgent[4]能够基于自然语言测试需求实现自动化的GUI交互和功能验证。 尽管测试目标各不相同，这些智能体通常遵循一个迭代过程：观察GUI状态、推理后续动作，并与应用进行交互。 现有研究主要聚焦于改进测试生成、探索和验证。 与之相反，我们的工作研究一个正交的问题：在不损害测试有效性的前提下，减少连续交互之间的等待开销。

paragraphs.en: Prior studies have investigated various waiting strategies to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of automated GUI testing. In web GUI testing, WEFix [ 39 ] analyzes browser UI changes to automatically generate explicit wait conditions, while Zhang et al. [ 16 ] identify expected DOM changes between consecutive actions to determine when tests should proceed. Moura et al. [ 40 ] further empirically evaluated different waiting mechanisms in Cypress tests, highlighting the importance of an efficient waiting strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究探索了多种等待策略，以提升自动化 GUI 测试的有效性与效率。 在 Web GUI 测试中，WEFix [ 39 ] 通过分析浏览器 UI 变化自动生成显式等待条件，而 Zhang 等人 [ 16 ] 则识别相邻操作之间预期的 DOM 变化，以确定测试何时应继续执行。Moura 等人 [ 40 ] 进一步对 Cypress 测试中不同的等待机制进行了实证评估，凸显了高效等待策略的重要性。

paragraphs.en: For mobile GUI testing, AdaT [ 14 ] employs a CNN-based model to infer GUI rendering states from screenshots and dynamically schedule subsequent test actions. Its follow-up work, WeReplay [ 15 ] , applies rendering inference to improve the efficiency of record-and-replay testing in WeChat. More recently, TurboDroid [ 17 ] combines static dependency analysis and runtime monitoring to determine when individual GUI widgets are ready for interaction. In contrast, our work focuses on adaptive waiting for GUI testing agents in industrial practice, where diverse GUI states and heterogeneous devices place greater demands on the generalizability of waiting strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 在移动 GUI 测试方面，AdaT [ 14 ] 采用基于 CNN 的模型从截图中推断 GUI 渲染状态，并动态调度后续测试动作。 其后续工作 WeReplay [ 15 ] 将渲染推断应用于微信，以提升录制回放测试的效率。 最近，TurboDroid [ 17 ] 结合静态依赖分析与运行时监控来判断各个 GUI 控件何时可以交互。 相比之下，我们的工作聚焦于工业实践中面向 GUI 测试智能体的自适应等待，其中多样化的 GUI 状态和异构设备对等待策略的泛化能力提出了更高要求。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in VLMs have enabled increasingly sophisticated GUI understanding. Some studies primarily focus on understanding GUI content from static screenshots. paragraphs.en: This paper shows that fixed waiting in GUI testing agents struggles to accommodate substantial variations in interface response times. Our industrial motivation study reveals that over 60% of the configured waiting time is spent idling after the interface is already ready for the next observation, resulting in substantial redundant waiting. To address this, we present WaitLens , a lightweight VLM-based adaptive waiting approach for GUI testing agents. By examining temporal GUI changes, WaitLens predicts whether the GUI is Ready and determines when to end waiting. Experiments on annotated GUI interaction recordings show that WaitLens achieves 86.08% accuracy, compared with 54.13% for its pretrained backbone, with a median latency of 0.243 s per model call. Furthermore, our industrial evaluation within Meituan’s production testing pipeline demonstrates WaitLens ’s real-life usability in substantially reducing redundant waiting while maintaining high observation reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 本文表明，GUI 测试智能体中的固定等待难以适应界面响应时间的大幅变化。 我们的工业动机研究显示，超过 60% 的配置等待时间被消耗在界面已经为下一次观察准备就绪之后的空转上，造成大量冗余等待。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 WaitLens，一种面向 GUI 测试智能体的轻量级基于 VLM 的自适应等待方法。 通过考察 GUI 的时序变化，WaitLens 预测 GUI 是否就绪（Ready）并决定何时结束等待。 在带标注的 GUI 交互录制数据上的实验表明，WaitLens 达到 86.08% 的准确率，而其预训练骨干模型仅为 54.13%，且每次模型调用的中位延迟为 0.243 秒。 此外，我们在美团生产测试流水线中的工业评估证明了 WaitLens 在实际应用中的可用性，能够在保持高观察可靠性的同时大幅减少冗余等待。
